text:
Markus Klein: Putting this here so it doesn’t get lost — can we lock the *pre-demo verification checklist* for the standard demo tenant + assign owners per region? Goal is “dashboards green, quota reset, model pinned” w/ zero surprises.

Markus Klein: Draft items I have right now:
- ✅ Login works (SSO/RBAC)
- ✅ Model pinned (scenario routes point to pinned versions)
- ✅ Routing/fallback rules intact (no accidental edits)
- ✅ Quotas reset (no 429s mid-demo)
- ✅ Dashboards green (p50/p95 latency, 5xx, throttles)
- ✅ Seed data reset (prompt sets + any saved evals)
- ✅ Plan B ready (canned outputs / screenshots)

Talia Benson: +1. Can we make it “T-30 min” steps vs “sometime today” steps? People keep doing quota reset the night before and then someone else burns tokens in the morning.

Stephanie Nguyen: Agree on T-30. Also we need clear *regional owner* so NA folks don’t ping Lukas at 7pm his time :)

Lukas Meyer: please 🙏. For EMEA we also need “EU-only routing is enabled” when we’re doing the data residency angle.

Chloe Martin: For dashboards: can we standardize on the saved view names? Right now I see folks using old links.

Logan Wright: +1. If we align on 2-3 “must check” panels, it’s faster than scrolling. Proposed minimum:
1) Demo Tenant Overview → Error rate (5xx) last 30m
2) Latency p95 by route last 30m
3) Throttles/429 count last 30m
If any are red/yellow, don’t wing it — ping oncall.

Cole Summers: On quotas: what’s the policy? If we’re making resets common, we should be explicit about what we’re resetting to.

Markus Klein: Great point. For live demos we want it intentionally generous but safe. Something like:
- 60k tokens/min burst (per API key)
- 600 requests/min (soft)
- streaming enabled
- max concurrency 20
(whatever the current “demo-safe defaults” are)

Cole Summers: Those numbers are fine for demo purposes but let’s document them as “demo tenant only” + include the command / console path to verify.

Simran Kaur: Re: model pinned — we should add an explicit check that the scenarios are still pointing to the pinned route aliases:
- `demo-chat-streaming` → `rw-chat-xx` (pinned)
- `demo-tool-calling` → `rw-chat-xx` (pinned)
- `demo-fallback` → primary + secondary models (both pinned)
We’ve had drift when folks “try a new model real quick”.

Rafael Mendes: SRE asks: please include *what to do when it’s not green*.
- If latency is high but error rate is ok: switch to “Hosted mini-demo” script (shorter) OR use canned output for the long response.
- If 5xx / capacity issues: switch region (NA ↔ EU) if allowed, otherwise run talk track w/ screenshots.
Also: if you ping me, include the dashboard link + time window.

Talia Benson: Can we put this into a checklist that AEs/SEs can literally copy/paste into the invite notes?

Markus Klein: Yep. Here’s an updated “T-30 min Preflight” checklist — feedback welcome:

*T-30 min: Demo Tenant Preflight*
1) Auth
- [ ] Confirm you can log in to Console (correct tenant)
- [ ] Confirm your API key works (curl a trivial request)

2) Model/version pinning
- [ ] In Console → Routes, verify demo routes point to pinned model versions (no “latest”)
- [ ] Verify `demo-fallback` has primary + secondary pinned + enabled

3) Quotas/rate limits
- [ ] Verify demo key quota is at demo-safe defaults (no leftover “reduced” limits)
- [ ] Run a 10s streaming test to ensure no 429s

4) Dashboards (last 30m)
- [ ] Error rate (5xx) green
- [ ] p95 latency by route within expected band
- [ ] Throttles/429 near zero

5) Seed/demo artifacts
- [ ] Prompt set / scenario scripts are the current version
- [ ] Any “expected output” snippets are copied locally (Plan B)

6) Plan B
- [ ] Screenshot pack / canned outputs ready
- [ ] If console is slow: skip clickpath, narrate + show 1 key screenshot

Stephanie Nguyen: Looks good. Add “turn off screen sharing notifications / Slack popups” 😅 (learned the hard way)

Lukas Meyer: For EMEA: add one line in routing check:
- [ ] If prospect cares about EU residency: confirm route policy is EU region only (no cross-region fallback)

Chloe Martin: For dashboards, can we include the exact saved views?
- “DEMO Tenant — Health (30m)”
- “DEMO Tenant — Latency by Route”
- “DEMO Tenant — Throttles/Quotas”
I’ll make sure those exist + are pinned in Console.

Logan Wright: I can also add thresholds in the doc so folks know what “within expected band” means. Even if it’s rough like:
- p95 < 2.5s for streaming first token (demo routes)
- 5xx < 0.5% in last 30m
- 429 == 0 ideally
(We can keep it as “guidance” not a promise.)

Cole Summers: For quota verification, we should avoid numbers in Slack that drift. Suggest we just reference “Demo Safe Defaults v1” and link to the runbook section. I’ll own keeping that section current.

Markus Klein: Fair. Let’s do owners + escalation:

*Owners*
- NA preflight owner (business hours): Markus Klein / backup Stephanie Nguyen
- EMEA preflight owner (business hours): Lukas Meyer
- Dashboards/saved views: Chloe Martin / Logan Wright
- Quotas/demo-safe defaults: Cole Summers
- SRE escalation for demo tenant incidents: Rafael Mendes (via #eng-sre)

Does that work?

Rafael Mendes: Works. One more thing: if it’s within 60 min of a customer call and something is broken, don’t try to “fix” routing rules yourself. Just switch to Plan B and file a ticket after.

Talia Benson: I’ll take this and put it into the one-page “Demo Tenant Reset Checklist” too. Will post the link here once updated.

Stephanie Nguyen: +1. Once we finalize, can we pin this thread or add it to the #sales channel bookmarks?

Markus Klein: Yes. After Talia posts the final link, I’ll pin that + the dashboard saved view names.

Chloe Martin: I’ll make the saved views today and drop direct Console links here.

Lukas Meyer: Thanks all. This is exactly what we need before the next round of exec demos.

Markus Klein: Cool — calling this “v1 preflight”. If anyone wants to propose additions, please keep it to <= 6 minutes total to run. If it takes longer, people won’t do it.
